text.traditional: 最近新聞提到，有個博士透過社群網站，認識了一個女網友，給了她很多錢以後，才知道被騙了。
text.simplified: 最近新闻提到，有个博士透过社群网站，认识了一个女网友，给了她很多钱以后，才知道被骗了。
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn xīnwén tídào, yǒu ge bóshì tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, rènshì le yíge nǚ wǎngyǒu, gěi le tā hěn duō qián yǐhòu, cái zhīdào bèi piàn le.
text.english: The news recently reported that a PhD holder got to know a woman through a social networking site, gave her a lot of money, and only then realized he had been swindled.

text.traditional: 我看過那個新聞。那個騙子假裝是大學生，故意找很老實的男生聊天，表面上對他們很好，等對方相信她以後就騙他們說，媽媽病了，需要錢看醫生。對吧？
text.simplified: 我看过那个新闻。那个骗子假装是大学生，故意找很老实的男生聊天，表面上对他们很好，等对方相信她以后就骗他们说，妈妈病了，需要钱看医生。对吧？
text.pinyin: Wǒ kàn guò nà ge xīnwén. Nà ge piànzi jiǎzhuāng shì dàxuéshēng, gùyì zhǎo hěn lǎoshí de nánshēng liáotiān, biǎomiàn shàng duì tāmen hěn hǎo, děng duìfāng xiāngxìn tā yǐhòu jiù piàn tāmen shuō, māma bìng le, xūyào qián kàn yīshēng. Duì ba?
text.english: I saw that news. That scammer pretended to be a college student, deliberately chatted with honest men, acted very kindly on the surface, and once they trusted her, lied that her mother was sick and needed medical money. Right?

text.traditional: 嗯。看到這類新聞，害我不敢上網交友了。你呢？你有這樣的經驗嗎？
text.simplified: 嗯。看到这类新闻，害我不敢上网交友了。你呢？你有这样的经验吗？
text.pinyin: Ēn. Kàndào zhèlèi xīnwén, hài wǒ bù gǎn shàngwǎng jiāoyǒu le. Nǐ ne? Nǐ yǒu zhèyàng de jīngyàn ma?
text.english: Yes. Seeing news like this makes me afraid to make online friends. What about you? Have you had any experience like that?

text.traditional: 以前遇過一次。剛開始我和對方只聊了幾句，後來有幾次聊電影聊得很開心，就越來越熟了，也會互相問候家人。
text.simplified: 以前遇过一次。刚开始我和对方只聊了几句，后来有几次聊电影聊得很开心，就越来越熟了，也会互相问候家人。
text.pinyin: Yǐqián yù guò yí cì. Gāng kāishǐ wǒ hé duìfāng zhǐ liáo le jǐ jù, hòulái yǒu jǐ cì liáo diànyǐng liáo de hěn kāixīn, jiù yuèláiyuè shóu le, yě huì hùxiāng wènhòu jiārén.
text.english: I encountered it once before. At first we only exchanged a few words, but later after talking happily about movies several times, we grew closer and began asking after each other's families.

text.traditional: 那時候你想進一步認識對方嗎？比如說跟對方見個面、吃個飯什麼的。
text.simplified: 那时候你想进一步认识对方吗？比如说跟对方见个面、吃个饭什么的。
text.pinyin: Nà shíhòu nǐ xiǎng jìnyíbù rènshì duìfāng ma? Bǐrú shuō gēn duìfāng jiàn ge miàn, chī ge fàn shénme de.
text.english: At that time did you want to get to know her further? For example, meeting in person, sharing a meal, or something like that?

text.traditional: 我沒想過跟她約會。不過大概過了一個月，她突然跟我說，家人發生嚴重的車禍，住院的費用很高，想跟我借十萬塊。
text.simplified: 我没想过跟她约会。不过大概过了一个月，她突然跟我说，家人发生严重的车祸，住院的费用很高，想跟我借十万块。
text.pinyin: Wǒ méi xiǎng guò gēn tā yuēhuì. Búguò dàgài guò le yíge yuè, tā túrán gēn wǒ shuō, jiārén fāshēng yánzhòng de chēhuò, zhùyuàn de fèiyòng hěn gāo, xiǎng gēn wǒ jiè shíwàn kuài.
text.english: I never considered dating her. However, after about a month, she suddenly told me her family was in a severe car accident with high hospitalization costs, and wanted to borrow 100,000 NTD.

text.traditional: 十萬塊？這麼多！你借她了嗎？
text.simplified: 十万块？这么多！你借她了吗？
text.pinyin: Shíwàn kuài? Zhème duō! Nǐ jiè tā le ma?
text.english: 100,000 NTD? That's so much! Did you lend it to her?

text.traditional: 當然沒。如果是兩萬塊以下，我可能願意借，十萬塊就太多了。再說，雖然對她不陌生，可是畢竟沒見過面，萬一借了以後才發現她說的都是假的，不但錢拿不回來，心也會很痛的。
text.simplified: 当然没。如果是两万块以下，我可能愿意借，十万块就太多了。再说，虽然对她不陌生，可是毕竟没见过面，万一借了以后才发现她说的都是假的，不但钱拿不回来，心也会很痛的。
text.pinyin: Dāngrán méi. Rúguǒ shì liǎngwàn kuài yǐxià, wǒ kěnéng yuànyì jiè, shíwàn kuài jiù tài duō le. Zàishuō, suīrán duì tā bú mòshēng, kěshì bìjìng méi jiàn guò miàn, wànyī jiè le yǐhòu cái fāxiàn tā shuō de dōu shì jiǎ de, búdàn qián ná bù huílái, xīn yě huì hěn tòng de.
text.english: Of course not. If it were under 20,000 NTD, I might have been willing, but 100,000 is too much. Besides, although she wasn't a stranger to me, we had never met after all. What if I lent it and only then found out that everything she said was false? Not only would I never get the money back, it would break my heart too.

text.traditional: 是啊。有一些人在網路上填假資料，要是我們不小心，很可能就成了被騙的對象。不過，也許那個網友真的很可憐，需要你的幫助。
text.simplified: 是啊。有一些人在网路上填假资料，要是我们不小心，很可能就成了被骗的对象。不过，也许那个网友真的很可怜，需要你的帮助。
text.pinyin: Shì a. Yǒu yìxiē rén zài wǎnglù shàng tián jiǎ zīliào, yàoshì wǒmen bù xiǎoxīn, hěn kěnéng jiù chéng le bèi piàn de duìxiàng. Búguò, yěxǔ nà ge wǎngyǒu zhēnde hěn kělián, xūyào nǐ de bāngzhù.
text.english: Indeed. Some people fill out fake profiles online; if we aren't careful, we could easily become scam targets. Still, perhaps that online friend really deserved pity and needed your help.

text.traditional: 我本來也很同情她，還問她媽媽得住院住多久。可是她一下子說半個月，一下子說一個月，故意不說清楚。後來，我發現她不誠實，就不再跟她聯絡了。
text.simplified: 我本来也很同情她，还问她妈妈得住院住多久。可是她一下子说半个月，一下子说一个月，故意不说清楚。后来，我发现她不诚实，就不再跟她联络了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái yě hěn tóngqíng tā, hái wèn tā māma děi zhùyuàn zhù duōjiǔ. Kěshì tā yíxiàzi shuō bàn ge yuè, yíxiàzi shuō yíge yuè, gùyì bù shuō qīngchǔ. Hòulái, wǒ fāxiàn tā bù chéngshí, jiù bú zài gēn tā liánluò le.
text.english: I was sympathetic at first, and asked how long her mother had to be hospitalized. But she said half a month one moment and a month the next, deliberately not making it clear. Later, finding her dishonest, I stopped contacting her.

text.traditional: 發現她不誠實？怎麼說呢？
text.simplified: 发现她不诚实？怎么说呢？
text.pinyin: Fāxiàn tā bù chéngshí? Zěnme shuō ne?
text.english: Found her dishonest? How so?

text.traditional: 那時有一個網友把自己網路交友上當的經驗，寫在部落格上。我看了以後，發現騙他的人和跟我借錢的網友是同一個人，她用同樣的方法騙了不少人。
text.simplified: 那时有一个网友把自己网路交友上当的经验，写在部落格上。我看了以后，发现骗他的人和跟我借钱的网友是同一个人，她用同样的方法骗了不少人。
text.pinyin: Nà shí yǒu yíge wǎngyǒu bǎ zìjǐ wǎnglù jiāoyǒu shàngdàng de jīngyàn, xiě zài bùluògé shàng. Wǒ kàn le yǐhòu, fāxiàn piàn tā de rén hé gēn wǒ jiè qián de wǎngyǒu shì tóng yíge rén, tā yòng tóngyàng de fāngfǎ piàn le bùshǎo rén.
text.english: At that time an internet user wrote on his blog about how he had been tricked while making friends online. After reading it, I realized that the person who cheated him and the online friend who wanted to borrow money from me were the same person—she had defrauded many people the same way.

text.traditional: 這種人實在太可惡了。不過那時候你差點兒被騙了，後來還敢上網交朋友嗎？
text.simplified: 这种人实在太可恶了。不过那时候你差点儿被骗了，后来还敢上网交朋友吗？
text.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng rén shízài tài kěwù le. Búguò nà shíhòu nǐ chàdiǎnr bèi piàn le, hòulái hái gǎn shàngwǎng jiāo péngyǒu ma?
text.english: That kind of person is truly despicable. But having nearly been scammed back then, did you dare make friends online afterward?

text.traditional: 雖然我也看不起這種人，但網路交友的方式還是不錯的，而且網友也不都是壞人。
text.simplified: 虽然我也看不起这种人，但网路交友的方式还是不错的，而且网友也不都是坏人。
text.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ yě kànbùqǐ zhè zhǒng rén, dàn wǎnglù jiāoyǒu de fāngshì háishì búcuò de, érqiě wǎngyǒu yě bù dōu shì huàirén.
text.english: Although I also look down on such people, making friends online is still a good way to meet people, and not everyone you meet online is bad.

text.traditional: 聽你這麼說，讓我回想起剛來臺灣的時候，透過社群網站，找到了會說日語的臺灣網友。他幫我找房子、認識環境，真的很感謝他。
text.simplified: 听你这么说，让我回想起刚来台湾的时候，透过社群网站，找到了会说日语的台湾网友。他帮我找房子、认识环境，真的很感谢他。
text.pinyin: Tīng nǐ zhème shuō, ràng wǒ huíxiǎng qǐ gāng lái Táiwān de shíhòu, tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, zhǎodào le huì shuō Rì yǔ de Táiwān wǎngyǒu. Tā bāng wǒ zhǎo fángzi, rènshì huánjìng, zhēnde hěn gǎnxiè tā.
text.english: Hearing you say that reminds me of when I first arrived in Taiwan: through a social networking site I found a Taiwanese online friend who spoke Japanese. He helped me find a place to live and get to know the area; I'm genuinely grateful to him.

text.traditional: 嗯！透過網路可以擴大交友的範圍，所以別因為有人被騙了，就拒絕使用這種交友方式。況且在真實生活中，騙子也不少啊！
text.simplified: 嗯！透过网路可以扩大交友的范围，所以别因为有人被骗了，就拒绝使用这种交友方式。况且在真实生活中，骗子也不少啊！
text.pinyin: Ēn! Tòuguò wǎnglù kěyǐ kuòdà jiāoyǒu de fànwéi, suǒyǐ bié yīnwèi yǒu rén bèi piàn le, jiù jùjué shǐyòng zhè zhǒng jiāoyǒu fāngshì. Kuàngqiě zài zhēnshí shēnghuó zhōng, piànzi yě bùshǎo a!
text.english: Yes! Through the internet we can expand our social circle, so don't reject this channel just because someone was scammed. Besides, there are plenty of swindlers in real life too!

text.traditional: 你說的對。網路交友還是可靠的，也能認識不少興趣相同的朋友。像你建立的健身社團網站，裡面有很多訊息，包括健身的影片、舉行活動的日期和地點等等，都很有用、很吸引人。
text.simplified: 你说的对。网路交友还是可靠的，也能认识不少兴趣相同的朋友。像你建立的健身社团网站，里面有很多讯息，包括健身的影片、举行活动的日期和地点等等，都很有用、很吸引人。
text.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de duì. Wǎnglù jiāoyǒu háishì kěkào de, yě néng rènshì bùshǎo xìngqù xiāngtóng de péngyǒu. Xiàng nǐ jiànlì de jiànshēn shètuán wǎngzhàn, lǐmiàn yǒu hěn duō xùnxī, bāokuò jiànshēn de yǐngpiàn, jǔxíng huódòng de rìqī hé dìdiǎn děngděng, dōu hěn yǒuyòng, hěn xīyǐn rén.
text.english: You're right. Making friends online can still be reliable, helping us meet friends with shared interests. For instance, the fitness club site you built contains rich content—workout videos, event dates, locations—all very useful and engaging.

text.traditional: 既然妳覺得很吸引人，歡迎加入，免費喔！
text.simplified: 既然你觉得很吸引人，欢迎加入，免费喔！
text.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ juéde hěn xīyǐn rén, huānyíng jiārù, miǎnfèi o!
text.english: Since you find it appealing, welcome aboard—it's free!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express achieving a goal or contacting others through a medium, person, or method with 透過.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示經過某人、事物或某種行為，達到某種目的或結果。

text.traditional: ……有個博士透過社群網站，認識了一個女網友……
text.simplified: ……有个博士透过社群网站，认识了一个女网友……
text.pinyin: …Yǒu ge bóshì tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, rènshì le yíge nǚ wǎngyǒu…
text.english: …A man with a PhD got to know a woman through a social networking site…

text.traditional: 人們習慣透過眼睛確認實際的情況，總是認為眼睛看到的就是對的。
text.simplified: 人们习惯透过眼睛确认实际的情况，总是认为眼睛看到的就是对的。
text.pinyin: Rénmen xíguàn tòuguò yǎnjīng quèrèn shíjì de qíngkuàng, zǒngshì rènwéi yǎnjīng kàndào de jiùshì duì de.
text.english: People are used to confirming the real situation through their own eyes, and always believe that what they see is right.

text.traditional: 康教授認為透過團體活動的方式，能讓學生學習到溝通的技巧。
text.simplified: 康教授认为透过团体活动的方式，能让学生学习到沟通的技巧。
text.pinyin: Kāng jiàoshòu rènwéi tòuguò tuántǐ huódòng de fāngshì, néng ràng xuéshēng xuéxí dào gōutōng de jìqiǎo.
text.english: Professor Kang believes that through group activities, students can learn communication skills.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 透過 represents a person, thing, or behavior by which a certain result is achieved.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Above / Below with 以上 / 以下
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that an amount is at or above a point with 以上, or below it with 以下.
grammarPages.explanation: 「以上」表示「超過」或「高於」某一點，同時也包含「某一點」，例如：「六十分以上及格」包括「六十分」。「以下」表示「低於」或「未達到」某一點。「以」與方位詞一起使用時，例如：以內、以外、以北、以南等，表示在某個一定的範圍。

text.traditional: 如果是兩萬塊以下，我可能願意借，十萬塊就太多了。
text.simplified: 如果是两万块以下，我可能愿意借，十万块就太多了。
text.pinyin: Rúguǒ shì liǎngwàn kuài yǐxià, wǒ kěnéng yuànyì jiè, shíwàn kuài jiù tài duō le.
text.english: If it is under 20,000, I might be willing to lend it; 100,000 would be too much.

text.traditional: 教授說成績八十分以上的學生才能得到獎學金，我剛好八十分，太好了。
text.simplified: 教授说成绩八十分以上的学生才能得到奖学金，我刚好八十分，太好了。
text.pinyin: Jiàoshòu shuō chéngjī bāshí fēn yǐshàng de xuéshēng cái néng dédào jiǎngxuéjīn, wǒ gānghǎo bāshí fēn, tài hǎo le.
text.english: The professor said only students who score 80 or above can get the scholarship. I got exactly 80. That's great!

text.traditional: 那家網路商店為了吸引客人，只要購物一千元以上，就可以免費把商品送到家。
text.simplified: 那家网路商店为了吸引客人，只要购物一千元以上，就可以免费把商品送到家。
text.pinyin: Nà jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn wèile xīyǐn kèrén, zhǐyào gòuwù yìqiān yuán yǐshàng, jiù kěyǐ miǎnfèi bǎ shāngpǐn sòng dào jiā.
text.english: To attract customers, that online store delivers goods home for free if you spend 1,000 or more.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 以上 means 超過(exceed) or 高於(be higher than) a certain point, and also includes 某一點(a certain point). For example, 六十分以上及格(grades above 60 points are considered passing) also includes 60 points. 以下 means 低於(below) or 未達到(not to have reached) a certain point. When 以 is used together with a position word, for example, 以內, 以外, 以北 or 以南, it means something within a certain range.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Think Highly of / Look Down Upon (看得起 / 看不起)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express respect or disdain toward someone with 看得起 ('respect/esteem') and 看不起 ('look down on').
grammarPages.explanation: 「看得起、看不起」表示對人的重視程度。「看得起」表示認為對方很重要；「看不起」有輕視對方的意思。第二冊第四課的語法「V 得起/V 不起」表示一個人的經濟能力能否負擔。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 看得起/看不起 + Person

text.traditional: 雖然我也看不起這種人，但網路交友的方式還是不錯的……
text.simplified: 虽然我也看不起这种人，但网路交友的方式还是不错的……
text.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ yě kànbùqǐ zhè zhǒng rén, dàn wǎnglù jiāoyǒu de fāngshì háishì búcuò de…
text.english: Although I look down on people like that too, making friends online is still not bad…

text.traditional: 你不可以看不起窮人，因為我們每個人都是一樣的，不能以地位、成就的高低來決定對人的態度。
text.simplified: 你不可以看不起穷人，因为我们每个人都是一样的，不能以地位、成就的高低来决定对人的态度。
text.pinyin: Nǐ bù kěyǐ kànbùqǐ qióngrén, yīnwèi wǒmen měi ge rén dōu shì yíyàng de, bùnéng yǐ dìwèi, chéngjiù de gāodī lái juédìng duì rén de tàidù.
text.english: You must not look down on poor people, because every one of us is the same; you can't decide how to treat people by how high or low their status and achievements are.

text.traditional: 主管看得起你，才把管理工廠工人的工作交給你，你要把握這個機會好好地表現。
text.simplified: 主管看得起你，才把管理工厂工人的工作交给你，你要把握这个机会好好地表现。
text.pinyin: Zhǔguǎn kàndeqǐ nǐ, cái bǎ guǎnlǐ gōngchǎng gōngrén de gōngzuò jiāo gěi nǐ, nǐ yào bǎwò zhè ge jīhuì hǎohǎo de biǎoxiàn.
text.english: The supervisor thinks highly of you, which is why he gave you the job of managing factory workers; you should seize this chance and do well.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 看得起, 看不起 indicates the level of respect shown to the other person. 看得起 means to consider the other party important; 看不起 means to look down on or to despise the other person. The grammar V 得起/V 不起, in the fourth lesson of Book 2, indicates whether a person can or can not afford something.

BOOK3_LESSON_ELEVEN_PART_TWO.title: Grammar 4–6 · Online Socializing Pros and Cons

dialogue.title: 短文 · 網路交友的優缺點

text.traditional: 自從無線網路出現的那天起，現代人的生活似乎就離不開網路了。
text.simplified: 自从无线网路出现的那天起，现代人的生活似乎就离不开网路了。
text.pinyin: Zìcóng wúxiàn wǎnglù chūxiàn de nà tiān qǐ, xiàndài rén de shēnghuó sìhū jiù lí bù kāi wǎnglù le.
text.english: Ever since the day wireless internet appeared, modern life seems unable to do without the internet.

text.traditional: 網路科技的進步，不但改變了從前的生活方式，就連人與人之間的關係，也產生了極大的變化。住在不同地區的人，可以透過網路互相交流，這一點是我們祖父母那個年代的人很難想像的。
text.simplified: 网路科技的进步，不但改变了从前的生活方式，就连人与人之间的关系，也产生了极大的变化。住在不同地区的人，可以透过网路互相交流，这一点是我们祖父母那个年代的人很难想像的。
text.pinyin: Wǎnglù kējì de jìnbù, búdàn gǎibiàn le cóngqián de shēnghuó fāngshì, jiù lián rén yǔ rén zhījiān de guānxì, yě chǎnshēng le jí dà de biànhuà. Zhù zài bùtóng dìqū de rén, kěyǐ tòuguò wǎnglù hùxiāng jiāoliú, zhè yìdiǎn shì wǒmen zǔfùmǔ nà ge niándài de rén hěn nán xiǎngxiàng de.
text.english: Advances in internet technology have not only changed the way people used to live; even relationships between people have changed enormously. People who live in different places can talk to each other online, something our grandparents' generation could hardly have imagined.

text.traditional: 在網路出現以前，想要做報告，得去圖書館借一堆書；想要認識新朋友，就非和本人面對面接觸不可。但現代社會只要有網路，就沒有時間和空間的限制，人人都可以隨時隨地傳訊息、查資料、認識世界各地的人。不但擴大了視野、增加了知識，甚至能和網友建立珍貴的友誼。但也因為這樣，越來越多人以網路傳訊息代替當面對話。時間久了，在真實世界中，人與人之間的關係就變得較冷淡了。
text.simplified: 在网路出现以前，想要做报告，得去图书馆借一堆书；想要认识新朋友，就非和本人面对面接触不可。但现代社会只要有网路，就没有时间和空间的限制，人人都可以随时随地传讯息、查资料、认识世界各地的人。不但扩大了视野、增加了知识，甚至能和网友建立珍贵的友谊。但也因为这样，越来越多人以网路传讯息代替当面对话。时间久了，在真实世界中，人与人之间的关系就变得较冷淡了。
text.pinyin: Zài wǎnglù chūxiàn yǐqián, xiǎngyào zuò bàogào, děi qù túshūguǎn jiè yì duī shū; xiǎngyào rènshì xīn péngyǒu, jiù fēi hé běnrén miàn duì miàn jiēchù bùkě. Dàn xiàndài shèhuì zhǐyào yǒu wǎnglù, jiù méiyǒu shíjiān hé kōngjiān de xiànzhì, rénrén dōu kěyǐ suíshí suídì chuán xùnxī, chá zīliào, rènshì shìjiè gèdì de rén. Búdàn kuòdà le shìyě, zēngjiā le zhīshì, shènzhì néng hé wǎngyǒu jiànlì zhēnguì de yǒuyí. Dàn yě yīnwèi zhèyàng, yuè lái yuè duō rén yǐ wǎnglù chuán xùnxī dàitì dāngmiàn duìhuà. Shíjiān jiǔ le, zài zhēnshí shìjiè zhōng, rén yǔ rén zhījiān de guānxì jiù biàn de jiào lěngdàn le.
text.english: Before the internet, if you wanted to write a report, you had to borrow a pile of books from the library; if you wanted to make new friends, you had to meet them face to face. But in modern society, as long as there is internet, there are no limits of time or space: anyone can send messages, look things up and get to know people from all over the world, anytime and anywhere. It not only broadens our horizons and adds to our knowledge; we can even build precious friendships with people we meet online. But because of this, more and more people send messages online instead of talking face to face. Over time, relationships between people in the real world have grown colder.

text.traditional: 在網路世界中，這種不必面對面的溝通方式，也讓部分不誠實的人，有機會用假資料到處騙人。例如，某人已經五十歲了，在網路上卻說自己才二十歲；有人已經有了老公或老婆，卻假裝自己單身。還有一些花心又不老實的人，用浪漫的話，讓渴望愛情的人或不懂事的青少年上當，那些騙子不僅可惡，還對不起社會。
text.simplified: 在网路世界中，这种不必面对面的沟通方式，也让部分不诚实的人，有机会用假资料到处骗人。例如，某人已经五十岁了，在网路上却说自己才二十岁；有人已经有了老公或老婆，却假装自己单身。还有一些花心又不老实的人，用浪漫的话，让渴望爱情的人或不懂事的青少年上当，那些骗子不仅可恶，还对不起社会。
text.pinyin: Zài wǎnglù shìjiè zhōng, zhè zhǒng búbì miàn duì miàn de gōutōng fāngshì, yě ràng bùfèn bù chéngshí de rén, yǒu jīhuì yòng jiǎ zīliào dàochù piàn rén. Lìrú, mǒu rén yǐjīng wǔshí suì le, zài wǎnglù shàng què shuō zìjǐ cái èrshí suì; yǒu rén yǐjīng yǒu le lǎogōng huò lǎopó, què jiǎzhuāng zìjǐ dānshēn. Háiyǒu yìxiē huāxīn yòu bù lǎoshí de rén, yòng làngmàn de huà, ràng kěwàng àiqíng de rén huò bù dǒngshì de qīngshàonián shàngdàng, nàxiē piànzi bù jǐn kěwù, hái duìbùqǐ shèhuì.
text.english: In the online world, this way of communicating without meeting face to face also gives some dishonest people the chance to cheat others with false information. For example, someone who is already fifty says online that he is only twenty; someone who already has a husband or wife pretends to be single. There are also fickle, dishonest people who use romantic words to fool people longing for love or naive teenagers. Those cheats are not only hateful; they also let society down.

text.traditional: 網路世界有美好的一面，也有危險的一面，網路交友同樣有優缺點。透過社群網站，可以交到好朋友，甚至找到理想的結婚對象；萬一不幸交到了壞朋友，錢被騙走了，就算怪自己也是沒有用的。畢竟網路只是提供一種更便利的交友方式給大家，至於要不要以網路交友取代傳統的交流方式，就看個人的選擇了。
text.simplified: 网路世界有美好的一面，也有危险的一面，网路交友同样有优缺点。透过社群网站，可以交到好朋友，甚至找到理想的结婚对象；万一不幸交到了坏朋友，钱被骗走了，就算怪自己也是没有用的。毕竟网路只是提供一种更便利的交友方式给大家，至于要不要以网路交友取代传统的交流方式，就看个人的选择了。
text.pinyin: Wǎnglù shìjiè yǒu měihǎo de yímiàn, yě yǒu wéixiǎn de yímiàn, wǎnglù jiāoyǒu tóngyàng yǒu yōu quē diǎn. Tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, kěyǐ jiāo dào hǎo péngyǒu, shènzhì zhǎodào lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng; wànyī búxìng jiāo dào le huài péngyǒu, qián bèi piàn zǒu le, jiùsuàn guài zìjǐ yě shì méiyǒu yòng de. Bìjìng wǎnglù zhǐshì tígōng yì zhǒng gèng biànlì de jiāoyǒu fāngshì gěi dàjiā, zhìyú yào bú yào yǐ wǎnglù jiāoyǒu qǔdài chuántǒng de jiāoliú fāngshì, jiù kàn gèrén de xuǎnzé le.
text.english: The online world has a good side and a dangerous side, and making friends online likewise has its pros and cons. Through social media you can make good friends and even find the ideal person to marry; but if you are unlucky enough to make bad friends and get cheated out of your money, blaming yourself won't help. After all, the internet only offers everyone a more convenient way to make friends; whether to replace the traditional ways of meeting people with online friendship is up to each person.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Highlight an unexpected, contrary result or reality using the adverb 卻 ('yet / however').
grammarPages.explanation: 「卻」作副詞，表示和事實或期望相反，放在主語後面、動詞前面，用來表示轉折。例如：他跟我約好在學校見面，等了半天，他卻沒來。

text.traditional: 某人已經五十歲了，在網路上卻說自己才二十歲……
text.simplified: 某人已经五十岁了，在网路上却说自己才二十岁……
text.pinyin: Mǒu rén yǐjīng wǔshí suì le, zài wǎnglù shàng què shuō zìjǐ cái èrshí suì…
text.english: Someone is already fifty years old, yet online he says he is only twenty…

text.traditional: 小馬是我的網友，我對他不陌生，可是面對面接觸時，我們卻聊不到幾句話。
text.simplified: 小马是我的网友，我对他不陌生，可是面对面接触时，我们却聊不到几句话。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ shì wǒ de wǎngyǒu, wǒ duì tā bú mòshēng, kěshì miànduìmiàn jiēchù shí, wǒmen què liáo búdào jǐ jù huà.
text.english: Xiao Ma is my online friend and he is no stranger to me, but when we meet face to face, we can hardly say a few words to each other.

text.traditional: 警察通知我室友，他家人發生了車禍，我以為他會很緊張，沒想到卻很冷靜。
text.simplified: 警察通知我室友，他家人发生了车祸，我以为他会很紧张，没想到却很冷静。
text.pinyin: Jǐngchá tōngzhī wǒ shìyǒu, tā jiārén fāshēng le chēhuò, wǒ yǐwéi tā huì hěn jǐnzhāng, méixiǎngdào què hěn lěngjìng.
text.english: The police informed my roommate that his family had a car accident; I thought he would be very nervous, but to my surprise he was very calm.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 卻 is an adverb, indicating things contrary to fact or expectation. It is often placed after the subject of the sentence or in front of the verb to indicate a transition. For example, 他跟我約好在學校見面，等了半天，他卻沒來。

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Live Up to / Let Down with 對得起 / 對不起
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express living up to expectations (對得起) or feeling guilty for letting someone down (對不起).
grammarPages.explanation: 「對得起」表示沒做不好或不應該的事，沒讓對方失望、生氣、丟臉。「對不起」的意思跟「對得起」相反。「對得起/對不起」後面可接事情的對象，例如：對得起老闆、對得起自己、對不起朋友、對不起社會。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 對得起/對不起 + Object

text.traditional: ……那些騙子不僅可惡，還對不起社會。
text.simplified: ……那些骗子不仅可恶，还对不起社会。
text.pinyin: …Nàxiē piànzi bù jǐn kěwù, hái duìbùqǐ shèhuì.
text.english: …Those scammers are not only despicable; they also let society down.

text.traditional: 李大華覺得父母工作很辛苦，要是他不好好讀書，怎麼對得起父母呢？
text.simplified: 李大华觉得父母工作很辛苦，要是他不好好读书，怎么对得起父母呢？
text.pinyin: Lǐ Dàhuá juéde fùmǔ gōngzuò hěn xīnkǔ, yàoshì tā bù hǎohǎo dúshū, zěnme duìdeqǐ fùmǔ ne?
text.english: Li Dahua feels his parents work very hard; if he does not study well, how could he face his parents?

text.traditional: 小陸常利用出差的機會，去夜店跟漂亮小姐約會，卻一點都不覺得對不起太太。
text.simplified: 小陆常利用出差的机会，去夜店跟漂亮小姐约会，却一点都不觉得对不起太太。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Lù cháng lìyòng chūchāi de jīhuì, qù yèdiàn gēn piàoliàng xiǎojiě yuēhuì, què yìdiǎn dōu bù juéde duìbùqǐ tàitai.
text.english: Xiao Lu often uses business trips as a chance to go to nightclubs and date pretty women, yet he doesn't feel at all that he is letting his wife down.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 對得起 means not doing something that should not be done; not letting the other party down, be angry, or embarrassed. On the contrary, 對不起 means being embarrassed or sorry for disappointing the other person. 對得起/對不起 can be followed by the object. For example, 對得起老闆, 對得起自己, 對不起朋友, 對不起社會.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.titleEnglish: As for / Turning to with 至於
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Pivot to an associated point, unresolved question, or secondary topic with 至於 ('as for...').
grammarPages.explanation: 「至於」當句子之間的轉折語，引出另一個與原來主題相關的話題或觀點。

text.traditional: 網路只是提供一種更便利的交友方式給大家，至於要不要以網路交友……
text.simplified: 网路只是提供一种更便利的交友方式给大家，至于要不要以网路交友……
text.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhǐshì tígōng yì zhǒng gèng biànlì de jiāoyǒu fāngshì gěi dàjiā, zhìyú yào bú yào yǐ wǎnglù jiāoyǒu…
text.english: The internet just offers everyone a more convenient way to make friends; as for whether or not to make friends online…

text.traditional: 那對情侶有結婚的打算，至於什麼時候舉行婚禮，還要問家長的意見。
text.simplified: 那对情侣有结婚的打算，至于什么时候举行婚礼，还要问家长的意见。
text.pinyin: Nà duì qínglǚ yǒu jiéhūn de dǎsuàn, zhìyú shénme shíhòu jǔxíng hūnlǐ, hái yào wèn jiāzhǎng de yìjiàn.
text.english: That couple plans to get married; as for when to hold the wedding, they still need to ask the parents for their opinion.

text.traditional: 我只知道教育制度的改善計畫是夏教授帶領的，至於詳細內容就得問他本人了。
text.simplified: 我只知道教育制度的改善计划是夏教授带领的，至于详细内容就得问他本人了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ zhīdào jiàoyù zhìdù de gǎishàn jìhuà shì Xià jiàoshòu dàilǐng de, zhìyú xiángxì nèiróng jiù děi wèn tā běnrén le.
text.english: I only know that Professor Xia leads the plan to improve the education system; as for the details, you'll have to ask him directly.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 至於 is used as a turning point or pivot between sentences. What is said after 至於 is related to the previous topic or viewpoint.
